summary: The document details the functionalities and controls associated with maintaining student user accounts in the HSPnet system. It includes operations for creating, updating, and managing user information, including password changes and email notifications.
purpose: The purpose of the MaintUserStudent document is to manage user accounts for students, including creation, modification, validation, and communication processes within the HSPnet system.

workflows.name: Update Student User
steps: Send email notification on change if applicable

business_rules: User creation requires uniqueness of username
Email notification depends on system settings and user session
validations: Email format validation using regular expression
Required fields validation for UserName and Email
conditions: User is considered active if checkbox 'active' is checked
Changes are saved only if validations pass
system_behavior: The system sends emails using predefined templates
Changes are reflected after user session validation
Visual elements such as error and warning panels can be toggled
dependencies: HSPnet.DataLayer namespace for accessing student data
exceptions: Error message is displayed if user creation or update fails due to existing username
Notification failure is recorded if email sending fails
